biomarkers.name: Methylation profiling
biomarkers.clinical_use: Distinguishes pineoblastoma molecular subgroups, including miRNA-processing-altered/RB1-altered and MYC/FOXR2-associated groups

biomarkers.name: RB1 (bilateral retinoblastoma + trilateral)
biomarkers.prevalence: Subset of pineoblastoma; classically associated with trilateral retinoblastoma
biomarkers.clinical_use: Bilateral retinoblastoma + pineoblastoma — evaluate for germline RB1

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small round blue cell tumour (pineoblastoma) or more mature pineocytic differentiation (pineocytoma), with variable rosette formation
variants: pineal parenchymal tumour of intermediate differentiation (grade 2 or 3)
papillary tumour of pineal region (distinct entity)

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Pineocytic rosettes in low-grade; small round blue cell morphology in pineoblastoma

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Pineal parenchymal cells (pineocytes) — related to photoreceptor lineage from evolutionary/developmental perspective
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neuroectoderm — pineal gland arises from the diencephalic roof; pineocytes share molecular features with retinal photoreceptors
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Spectrum from mature (pineocytoma — retained pineocyte differentiation) to intermediate (pineal parenchymal tumour of intermediate differentiation) to embryonal (pineoblastoma — undifferentiated); synaptophysin+, chromogranin variable
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Shared developmental relationship to retinal photoreceptor programs may help explain the association of pineoblastoma with germline RB1 in trilateral retinoblastoma, but pineoblastoma and retinoblastoma are distinct tumour entities rather than the same cell of origin
